headline: Sukanya will continue to earn 8.2% and PPF 7.1% interest: No change in small savings scheme interest rates for 33 months
summary: The government kept interest rates unchanged for small savings schemes for the October-December quarter of FY2026-27. PPF stays at 7.1% and Sukanya Samriddhi at 8.2%.
why: Small savings rates are set quarterly by the Indian government and influence household savings flows and benchmark retail debt returns.
